subject: Renewal amendment: EU data residency + APAC rollout / failover plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novamedical.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal amendment: EU data residency + APAC rollout / failover plan

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our alignment, I’m putting a short proposal on the table so Legal / Platform can evaluate during renewal. High level:

- Renewal: 12-month renewal converted to a 24-month committed contract (option to revert at renewal if needed).
- Data residency: persist customer data for EU-based tenants in our EU region (physical storage & primary writes in eu-central-1).
- APAC rollout: phased APAC read-replicas and an on-demand APAC inference pool for latency-sensitive traffic (target Q3 start).
- Cross-region failover: active → passive failover with automated DNS cutover and an SLA-backed RTO (detailed below).

Attachments: renewal_amendment_v2.pdf (amendment draft), infra_runbook_eu_apac.md (technical plan stub).

Questions for you: is Novamedical legal ok with a contract amendment vs. a brand-new master services agreement? Also, does your compliance team require certified-data-center lists / SOC2 link?

Suggested next steps: I can loop in our infra lead and Sales Ops for pricing & timelines — cc’d Marissa for quota/discounts. If this looks directionally correct I’ll prepare a DocuSign amendment.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

From: Elena Rossi <elena@novamedical.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@novamedical.com>, ops@novamedical.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 16:48:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: EU data residency + APAC rollout / failover plan

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — this direction makes sense. A few clarifying items from Platform and Legal before we move:

1) EU residency scope: does this cover only customer-generated data at rest, or also logs, analytics, and backups? We need a clear list for regulators.
2) KMS: can you confirm support for customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for EU tenant encryption at rest?
3) Failover SLA: what is the expected RTO/RPO and the test cadence you propose for cross-region failover?
4) Pricing: what is the delta for a 24-month commit vs. 12 months, and do you offer migration credits to cover any onboarding work?

Legal prefers an amendment to the existing MSA if we can get precise residency language. Ops asked whether the APAC rollout can be staged so that only a subset of traffic uses APAC nodes initially for latency-sensitive endpoints.

If you can send a redlined amendment + a short operational timeline, we’ll circulate internally.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform, Novamedical
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal amendment: EU data residency + APAC rollout / failover plan

Laura / Karthik —

Looping you both in to scope pricing and the infra timeline. Customer (Novamedical, DEAL-9342) wants: EU residency for persisted data (incl. backups & certain logs), APAC staged rollout, and cross-region failover with SLA.

Quick asks:
- Laura: pricing delta for 24mo vs 12mo, recommended migration credit to get them across the finish line, and approval for a 10% early-signature discount if they sign by 2027-04-20.
- Karthik: high-level timeline (weeks), operational constraints (KMS BYOK), and whether active-passive with warm replicas meets their needs.

I’ve attached the initial draft amendment (renewal_amendment_v2.pdf).

Thanks — Vivek
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal amendment: EU data residency + APAC rollout / failover plan

Vivek / Laura —

Technical summary and timeline (high level):

- EU residency scope: primary data + backups + audit logs can be restricted to EU. Operational logs (high-volume metrics) can be redacted/aggregation-only and retained outside EU if required; we can provide a separate retention policy doc.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration; key material stays in customer KMS or HSM. We'll need an IAM onboarding window (~2 weeks).
- Failover approach: active (EU primary) / passive (APAC warm replicas) with async replication. Expected RPO: ~30s-2m depending on workload; RTO target: 15-30 minutes for automated cutover. Full failover runbook + pre-cutover test plan included in infra_runbook_eu_apac.md.
- APAC rollout: phased 3-stage plan — pilot (10% traffic, 2 weeks), ramp (50%, 3 weeks), full (remaining). Total delivery from sign-off: ~10-12 weeks.
- Capacity/pricing driver: warm replicas + reserved capacity in APAC will add a committed GPU pool (recommend Dedicated tier Small to Medium). Estimated delta: +18-25% on top of current committed spend for the first 12 months (detailed estimate requires exact QPS/payloads).

I attached infra_runbook_eu_apac.md with the SRE checklist. We should schedule a 30–45m technical kickoff with Novamedical ops to confirm the pilot endpoints and cutover windows.

—Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novamedical.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed commercial terms — Novamedical renewal (DEAL-9342)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the prompt feedback. Based on Karthik’s technical plan, please find the commercial bullets we propose for the amendment: 

- Term: 24 months starting at signature date (with an option to exit at the 24mo renewal if regulatory needs change).
- Pricing: 10% discount on per-token generation price relative to current list for the 24-month committed volume.
- Capacity: reserved APAC capacity equivalent to "Dedicated Small" (X GPUs) for the first 12 months; additional burst capacity billed at overage rates.
- Migration credit: one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of annual committed spend applied at signature to cover migration/service setup.
- Early-sign: additional 5% credit if amendment signed by 2027-04-20.
- Residency warrant: we’ll add explicit language that persisted customer data, backups, and audit logs for EU tenants will be stored in AWS eu-central-1 and will not be exported without written permission; operational metrics will be scoped separately.

Attached: renewal_amendment_v2.pdf (with redlines) — I’ve updated the residency clause and the billing schedule. If the terms above look good, I’ll create a DocuSign amendment and route to Legal. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9342

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novamedical.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@novamedical.com>, ops@novamedical.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:23:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial terms — Novamedical renewal (DEAL-9342)

Laura / Vivek —

This looks good — we’ve reviewed the redline and Legal is comfortable with the residency language and migration credit. We signed the amendment and uploaded it here: signed_amendment_novamedical.pdf (attached).

Request: can we schedule the technical kickoff / pilot planning week of 2027-04-20? Also want to confirm target start for EU residency enforced writes: 2027-06-01. Ops asked for a 2-week window for a DR failover test — can you confirm dates once SRE has availability?

Once we have the DocuSign link I’ll finalize and countersign.

Thanks —
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform | Novamedical
